name: 27-linux-lsof-exit1-stderr-not-trusted
description: lsof exits 1 with empty stdout and a stderr message. That is not a trusted 'nothing matched'. The table shows 3000 occupied with no visible owner, so the endpoint is permission_limited and the plan exits failed. It is never reported free.

lsof -nP +c 0 -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -FpcnT.stderr: lsof: WARNING: can't stat() fuse.gvfsd-fuse file system
